Name: [Smoke] ui.handlers.hullkurven_handlers — Hullkurven tab opens and controls are visible
Precondition: Application is installed and launchable. Valid sample protocol and PTU2 data are available in measurement_data/protocol_files and measurement_data/ptu_files.
Objective: Verify the Hullkurven tab can be opened and basic controls are present.
Test Script (Expected Result): Main window opens and no startup crash occurs.
Hullkurven tab is visible with Start, Input Setup, and Plot Setup sections.

Name: [Smoke] ui.handlers.hullkurven_handlers.init_widgets — default values are prefilled
Precondition: Application is running and Hullkurven tab is open. At least one valid protocol is loaded and parsed so PTU2 data is available for Hullkurven evaluation.
Objective: Verify default widget values are initialized for a first run.
Test Script (Step): Inspect Input Setup checkboxes and text fields.
Test Script (Expected Result): Azimuth Diagrams is checked, Elevation Diagrams is unchecked, Min Sigma is -10, and Max Sigma is 10.

Test Script (Step): Inspect Pattern Limits Method and Plot Setup fields.
Test Script (Expected Result): Sigma-based is selected, X-Scale Autoscale is unchecked, X-Scale Azimuth is 90, and X-Scale Elevation is 45.

Name: [Smoke] ui.handlers.hullkurven_handlers.hullkurven_start — start with defaults
Precondition: Application is running and Hullkurven tab defaults are visible. At least one valid protocol is loaded and parsed so PTU2 data is available for Hullkurven evaluation.
Objective: Verify Start action executes without error using default values.
Test Script (Expected Result): Application remains responsive and no error dialog appears.

Test Script (Step): Open the log table and inspect recent entries.
Test Script (Expected Result): An info log entry indicates Hullkurven start evaluation was requested.

Name: [Smoke] ui.handlers.hullkurven_handlers — tab remains usable after repeated starts
Precondition: Application is running and Hullkurven tab is open. At least one valid protocol is loaded and parsed so PTU2 data is available for Hullkurven evaluation.
Objective: Verify basic repetitive use does not degrade tab usability.
Test Script (Step): Click Start three times in a row.
Test Script (Expected Result): Each click is accepted and application stays responsive.

Test Script (Step): Change Min Sigma from -10 to -8 and click Start again.
Test Script (Expected Result): New value is accepted and Start still runs without crash.
